To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a descriptor can significantly enhance the performance of a CNN; (2) by incorporating a SURF image descriptor, we report a CNN that outperforms the state of art in terms of accuracy and speed; and (3) the proposed descriptor enhanced convolutional neural network can be trained from scratch, i.e. without the need of a pre-trained network.

the proposed CNN with a descriptor input outperforms all state of the art methods in terms of accuracy, that the proposed CNN can be trained in a few minutes, and that it does not require a pretrained network.
a convolutional neural networks with SURF descriptor as input achieves state of the art accuracy for indoor localization applications and is faster than the state of the art.
In summary, our research is concerned with
indoor localization using a descriptor-enhanced convolutional neural network (CNN).
the design and development of a descriptor enhanced convolutional neural network for indoor localization applications.

the following aspects: 1) a novel CNN architecture with a descriptor as input; 2) the use of the descriptor as an additional input channel to the network and the effect on the training process; 3) a comparison with state-of-the-art CNN-based localization methods; 4) the use of a pretrained network to initialize the network parameters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CNN-SURF descriptor is a simple, accurate, and fast approach for indoor localization.
our proposed CNN model with the SURF descriptor is the best performing model for indoor localization.
the descriptor enhanced CNN outperforms the state-of-the-art methods for indoor localization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose to enhance the performance of CNN by adding an image descriptor as a feature vector.
we are able to achieve state of art accuracy for the localization of a robot using a convolutional neural networks and a SURF descriptor.
we are able to localize a device in a building with a 2.3m error using a single image.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a descriptor is a very useful feature for indoor localization and can be incorporated into a convolutional neural networks.
the descriptor can be easily integrated with a CNN, and it can improve the performance of the CNN.
adding image descriptors to the input of a convolutional network is an effective way to improve performance.
